adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to GET /v1/users, the cheap authenticated account read used by the pinned validator. Official list-users docs also accept organization, limit, and offset; native healthcheck sends no query, matching the pinned list_users handler.

Official GET /v1/users accepts organization, limit (max 200), and offset. The pinned list_users action has an empty input schema and sends no query; native users.list follows that handler and returns raw Missive JSON under data.
Optional limit and offset match official GET /v1/organizations and the pinned paginationQuery. Returns raw Missive JSON under data.
Official GET /v1/teams accepts organization, limit, and offset. The pinned list_teams handler sends no query; native teams.list follows that handler.
Optional limit and offset match official GET /v1/contact_books. Returns raw Missive JSON under data.

contact_book is required. Optional order, limit, offset, modified_since, include_deleted, and search match official GET /v1/contacts and the pinned compactObject query. Boolean include_deleted is sent as a stringified query value when present. Returns raw Missive JSON under data.
